summary: Completed comprehensive testing of three new features: (1) SINKRONKAN KG - stock synchronization for whole chicken products with stock_sync field, preview, and sync endpoints; (2) PERINGATAN SELISIH - gap warning banner and sync UI on /stok page; (3) RIWAYAT PRODUK TERHAPUS - deleted products history on /audit page. All backend APIs (17/17) and frontend UI tests passed successfully.
